posts.name: Ananthanarayanan M S
posts.cooked: Logged in to OPPE VM today to try and do NPPE problems. However as soon as I logged in I got logged out before I could do any problems in there. Please help.

posts.name: Abhay Singh Chauhan
posts.cooked:
I have a doubt regarding my old VM. It is not running and shows as “Closed.”
My system command is also re-oppe, so I believe I will receive a new VM on 13th December.

Could you please provide a solution for this issue?
Thank you.

posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Dear student,

The OPPE VM is accessible one hour before the exam. You can practise NPPE from the VM which was shared with you the first time.

Thank you
Prakhar Arora
